context: Hina asks Sakura how to become a writer.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: さくらお姉ちゃん、ひな、書きたい。
lines.en: Sakura sister, Hina wants to write!
lines.style: Bright, eager opening. Childish vocal quality—unfiltered excitement. Leans forward into the request. Genuine warmth, no artifice. Audible smile.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.en: Really? That makes me so happy.
lines.style: Surprised and genuinely delighted. Soft intake of breath. Warmth rises naturally—not performed, felt. Eyes light up. Settles into the moment with her.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: Big sister, will you teach me?
lines.style: Hopeful, open question. Voice rises slightly at the end. Trust in it—she's asking someone she knows will say yes. Small, real voice seeking guidance.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.en: Yeah, slowly. We'll do it together.
lines.style: Quiet commitment in the yes. Slows her pace deliberately. Tenderness underneath—this matters. Not lecturing, anchoring. Steady presence that says: you're safe here.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Determination without strain. Small voice making a real promise. Sincere effort audible—not trying to impress, just trying. Slight lean forward into the commitment.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.en: Dreams are worth chasing. That's what matters.
lines.style: Quieter, more thoughtful. A moment of genuine reflection. Not performative wisdom—something she believes. Speaks to the child and to herself. Tender and serious.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: You can talk to me anytime, okay?
lines.style: Soft closing. Direct eye contact implied. Not a generic reassurance—a real promise. Warmth in the certainty. Leaves space for her to respond, doesn't need to fill it.
